newsitem.title: ITALY: Olivetti confirms De Benedetti resigning.
newsitem.headline: Olivetti confirms De Benedetti resigning.

text.p: Italian information technology group Olivetti confirmed Tuesday that Carlo De Benedetti was stepping down as group chairman and board member.

Olivetti said in a statement the board had nominated board member Antoni Tesone as chairman and proposed the nomination of an executive committee to include Tesone, managing director Francesco Caio and board members Rodolfo De Benedetti and Franco Girard.

Olivetti shares fell more than 5 percent on the Milan stock exchange on Tuesday as rumours abounded about the company's financial problems and on talk of conflict between De Benedetti and new Managing Director Francesco Caio, who took over from Corrado Passera in July.
The ANSA news agency later reported that De Benedetti would also leave the Olivetti board. It said Caio would be in charge of day-to-day management.
